taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a shrub 2 m to 4 m tall.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: up to 6 m tall, as a small tree.

traits.life_span.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a long-lived shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a woody shrub or small tree.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: deciduous.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Leaves in opposite pairs, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 185275497, 210771524, 357643956, 347280704, 182092852, 251680718, 79916821, 45468662): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 4 cm to 8 cm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 1.5 cm to 3 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: petioles 5 mm to 10 mm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves elliptic.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves finely crenate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: inflorescence a cyme, 3-10-flowered.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flowers in small stalked cymes from the leaf axils, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 185275497, 210771524, 357643956, 347280704, 182092852, 251680718, 79916821, 45468662): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: cyme 3-10-flowered.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: cymes 2 cm to 4 cm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: flowers 8-10 mm.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: floral formula K4 C4 A4 G(4).

traits.flower_colour.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: flowers greenish-yellow to greenish-white; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 263, Euonymus europaeus: fruit a capsule, 4-lobed, pink.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 263, Euonymus europaeus: capsule 1 cm long, 1-1.5 cm in diameter.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 263, Euonymus europaeus: capsule 1 cm long, 1-1.5 cm in diameter.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 263, Euonymus europaeus: capsule pink, the seeds' aril orange; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.flowering_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 262, Euonymus europaeus: flowering April to June.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: capsules ripe September and October.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: an upright shrub of green twigs and finely toothed elliptic leaves in pairs, with small greenish four-petalled flowers in stalked clusters, and pink four-lobed capsules in autumn.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for spindle from its sources and the photos the traits cite; the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 3.0 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
